description: A feathered, long-necked dinosaur with a small beaked head stands in a dense dark forest, reaching up with one arm to pull down a leafy branch. Its hand ends in large curved, scythe-like claws, and a second set of claws hangs off its other hand near the body. The painting is in a loose oil-brush style with greens and browns, and there are no visible letters, frame or border.
